verdict.rationale: gstack's architecture docs describe a first-party compiled CLI (`$B`) that fronts its persistent headless Chromium daemon and serves as the fallback when the Aside browser is unavailable. Otherwise gstack is delivered mainly as slash-command skills run inside host agents like Claude Code, not as a general-purpose standalone CLI. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose gstack CLI covering skills, setup and workflows; a CLI command reference; independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
